svg.text: One floating object. Six fixed ribs. The lake completes the rings; light makes the handoff.
Six upper arcs and their reflections
At oblique angles the arcs cross
in projection, not in physical space.
A restrained glow leaves one rib as
the next catches it across an apparent
Two illustrated viewpoints of one hull.
Offset rib; colour for clarity only
Crossings happen in the viewer’s sightline.
No projected ring or mechanical motion.
INDICATIVE OPTICAL STUDY / NOT A SITE SURVEY OR CONSTRUCTION DRAWING
